s01521.summary: Isolde prunes lemon trees as ex-husband Desmond arrives with pastries and Greta looks on.
Desmond makes small talk and she brushes off his pastries, closed account and card.
They spar about coats and weight; Desmond finally raises the flat lease.
Both admit they cannot be in a room with or without the other.
Desmond weighs a lemon, Isolde agrees to wait three weeks, Greta leaves them alone.
Desmond offers the almond pastry and Isolde takes half.

s00379.summary: Exhausted Dr. Saoirse examines dying Helena in a blizzard-bound field hospital.
Saoirse explains the lung injury; Gregor demands surgery despite the generator running low.
Gregor forbids the operation and seizes Saoirse's wrist as she raises the scalpel.
Helena wakes and tells Gregor to let go; his grip loosens.

s00484.summary: Deborah, Raj and intern Chloe gather in a conference room for a synergy sprint.
Raj skewers the vague rocket initiative as fictional and a prelude to layoffs.
Chloe asks about the stale fruit bowl and Deborah deflects with corporate talk.
Raj resigns, takes the fruit and leaves; Chloe follows him out.

s01806.summary: Four travelers descend into a hollow of humming standing stones at twilight.
The stones sing louder; Maeve says they are remembering, and Dobbin finds writing.
The inscription demands naming a lost loved one; nobody wants to go first.
Sir Gervase speaks Ysolde's name, then Quillon names Tamsyn, opening a door of light.

s01973.summary: A tall man picks a lock in a mini-golf clock tower; a woman sneaks in.
They whisper-bicker about timing and a cop eating pierogi while he works the lock.
The lock opens to a steel box; he slips and uses her name Dolores.
He gives his own name, Walt, and she stows the box in her bakery tote.
Headlights sweep in; they crouch together and she takes his hand.

s02443.summary: Callum sits at a lone woman's table in a near-empty dining car.
They order dinner, trade names and accountant jokes, and laugh.
An elderly couple bicker, call them a handsome pair, and join in toasts.
Lights die, brakes scream, glass shatters, and Callum and Nadia grab hands.
The train stops; by match flame Nadia asks his surname, Fairbrother.

s02280.summary: Judge Littlefield gets a last haircut as the gallows come down and friends see him off.
Wren has the mare saddled; Littlefield plans to ride south and entrusts the bench.
Rosie finishes; Littlefield pays and goes as he is, skipping the shave.

s01424.summary: Odalys and Hans-Peter cross a silent frozen reservoir toward a survey stake.
As Odalys celebrates, the ice groans and cracks beneath them.
The sled tips and the sample case sinks as they lie flat on the ice.
They crawl to shore; Hans-Peter pulls Odalys up and they sit panting.

s01360.summary: Divorcing Fiona, Gideon and family wait stiffly; Jolene offers a coffee Fiona refuses.
Fiona snaps at Gideon and at Jolene calling her son sweetheart.
Five adults square off, voices rising, until a receptionist opens the door.
Hana apologizes, everyone sits, and Fiona finally accepts the coffee.

s01726.summary: Eamon joins Tavita and Roz on the roof; a flashlight beam forces them down.
Relieved, they shove and tease each other about being scared.
Roz prods Tavita to admit he is moving to Ohio in August.
Eamon counts sixty-one nights left and Roz photographs the three of them.

s00998.summary: Terrified Greta staggers into an ice-fishing hut and bolts the door.
A recorded cheery voice plays; something scrapes the roof and walls toward the door.
The door handle turns and the hut is shoved; she kills the lantern.
The recorder warns not to open the door; the bolt slides back on its own.

s01192.summary: Sheriff Jedediah finds the pump dry and suspects the well holds something.
Jedediah accuses Lockhart of dropping bodies in the well; Lockhart denies it.
Jedediah descends; Abby half-draws her rifle to stop Lockhart.
Jedediah finds the body of Arliss in the well and asks to be pulled up.
Abby and Lockhart reluctantly haul the rope together.

s00173.summary: Stranded by a wrecked jeep, Loretta hides the empty canteen as tempers fray.
Harlan proposes walking four miles to a well; Dorothy and Loretta doubt him.
Loretta hands over the empty canteen; sisters share a silent understanding.
Dorothy straightens Loretta's hat, says four miles, and leads everyone walking.

s01181.summary: A young soldier alone in a salt mine finally radios for help.
Command tells Almeida the extraction was cancelled.
Almeida slides to the floor; Command stays on the line as his lamp dies.

s00268.summary: Aminata and Dav work the lunar relay console and notice odd telemetry drift.
A message greets Kestrel-Four from their own transmitter; they argue it's no loopback.
Dav proposes pranks or hallucination; Aminata confirms oxygen is fine.
The sender says be not afraid and look up; a ring of lights appears.
Frozen, Aminata takes Dav's protein bar and bites it as they watch the sky.

s01992_1.summary: Four climbers count each other and realize Toby is missing.
Ranger Hester returns a found camera and chips at the ice wall to reach Toby.

s00184_1.summary: The Bailiff returns Ruth a dropped exhibit; she says the man will walk free after eleven years.

s00528.summary: Lou sips sherry with funeral proprietor Althea, then says her account is seventeen thousand short.
Spats presents the ledger; Althea unfazed says numbers never lie, people do.
Althea rings a bell and coffin lids open to a dozen gun barrels.
Lou toasts her husband; Althea clinks glasses while the waltz plays.

s01430.summary: Perpetua runs a fire drill for an empty floor with Alistair and Lola.
The alarm stops and Perpetua hears it was a real fire; all three run.
At the stairwell she says it was just a burned casserole.

s00105.summary: HR director Magdalena begins an informal meeting with supervisor Barry and union rep Petronella.
Magdalena shows a photo of a gherkin in the Reuben line; Barry blames systems.
Confronted with camera footage, Barry admits he fed relish to a stray cat.
Petronella pours him tea in the thermos cap, and he takes it.

s01962.summary: Anselmo barks orders to his chaotic family in the minivan before the car wash.
Foam hits the glass and Anselmo mutters it's fine, glancing nervously at Grandma Fumiko.

s00608.summary: Philomena, Grady and Tucker sit in tense silence in a closed planetarium cafe.
Tucker complains the mural's Jupiter is too small; Grady offers Philomena a fresh coffee.
Tucker eyes a drawer while Grady is away; Philomena stares him down.
Grady pours coffee and sits between them, close to both, around an unnamed thing.

s01343.summary: Marguerite is pinned in a crevasse; Toby and belayer Izzy shout to coordinate.
The ice cracks and snow falls; Toby urges cutting the rope while she resists.
In the quiet, Toby descends and frees her harness as the ice holds.
They are hauled up and collapse on the glacier, swearing never again.

s02028.summary: A crew in a flower cold room prepares to open a vault with a guessed code.
Tim worries about eleven minutes in the cold among ranunculus.
Gwendolyn tries two codes and the keypad rejects both.
She opens the flower box to a brass drill, the real plan, and begins drilling.

s01571.summary: Five unwilling guests gather in the lighthouse kitchen as storm winds howl.
Hester says someone put out the lamp; suspicion falls on keyholders and Yuki.
Hester and Bridget stand and trade accusations about the ledger; Pavel steps between.
Heavy footsteps sound on the dark tower stair above them.

s02342.summary: Salon guests sip tea in a trembling charade as revolutionary dusk falls.
Louise hears a drum; a fist hammers the door as Madame pours tea.

s01637.summary: Juniper is stuck alone in a stalled cable car, calming herself aloud.
Her radio gets only static; a bolt shears and the car lurches.
She breathes, then forces the ceiling hatch release open.
Rescuer Bashir drops in, harnesses Juniper, and jokes her calm.
He lifts her through the hatch into daylight, then follows.
